title: India Shines on Asian Games Day 15 with Multiple Gold Medals
indian_angle: India secured several gold medals across various sports, highlighting a strong performance on the penultimate day of the Asian Games.
summary: Day 15 of the Asian Games 2026 saw India clinch historic golds through Kumkum and Pranavi, along with Aman's wrestling gold and the men's cricket team's triumph.

title: Pranavi Urs Wins Historic Gold in Asian Games Golf, Women's Team Takes Silver
indian_angle: Pranavi Urs became the first Indian woman golfer to win an Asian Games gold, with the women's team also securing a silver medal.
summary: Pranavi Urs overcame an early triple bogey to secure India's first women's golf gold at the Asian Games, while the Indian women's team earned a silver.

title: Kumkum Mohod Clinches Historic Recurve Gold and Olympic Quota at Asian Games
indian_angle: Kumkum Mohod made history as the first Indian woman to win an individual recurve Asian Games medal, also securing an Olympic quota for India.
summary: 17-year-old Kumkum Mohod delivered a stellar performance to win individual recurve gold and an Olympic quota, a significant achievement for Indian archery.

title: Aman Clinches Gold in Men's 57kg Freestyle Wrestling at Asian Games
indian_angle: Aman secured a gold medal for India in the men's 57kg freestyle wrestling, adding to his previous Asian Games bronze.
summary: Aman won his second Asian Games medal, upgrading his previous bronze to a gold in the men's 57kg freestyle wrestling event.

title: India Defeats Pakistan by 19 Runs to Win Asian Games Cricket Gold
indian_angle: The Indian men's cricket team secured a gold medal at the Asian Games by defeating arch-rivals Pakistan in the final.
summary: India claimed the Asian Games men's cricket gold, beating Pakistan by 19 runs in a thrilling final match.
